instruction.text: Which things can connect to the internet? Drag the images to the correct group.
The Ellis family have moved into a new house. They haven’t set up an internet connection yet. What do they need to do? Fill in the gaps.

atoms.b: Firstly, the Ellis family need to get a ((++contract meal)) with an internet provider. This is a company that provides your house with access to ((++the_internet electricity)).
After getting a contract, a ((++technician doctor)) will come to your house and set up the ((++internet_connection gas_system)).
For the Ellis family to be able to use the internet on all their different ((++devices books)), they’ll need a ((++router clock)). This is what provides devices with access to the internet.

instruction.text: You usually connect to a router wirelessly through Wi-Fi. Select the diagram that shows a wireless connection.
Read the text and answer the true or false questions.

atoms.text:
To connect your phone to the internet when you’re out and about, you either need to connect to another Wi-Fi network (such as in a café), or use mobile data.

You can get mobile data from a mobile network provider. You usually pay the company a monthly fee to be able to connect to their network.

atoms.a: You can only connect to the internet from home.
To connect your smartphone to the internet, you need either a mobile data plan or a Wi-Fi connection.
You don’t have to pay for a mobile data plan.
